Messages.Author: Dasein
Messages.Body:
OK say I put a Blood Turnip on my predator’s Muddled Vampire Hunter
(which I actually did the other day, it was quite funny). Later on, my
vampire Terrence (who is an anarch) gets into combat with Muddles.
Blood Turnip says to move one blood or life to the opposing minion.
What exactly happens here?
Scenario A: A life counter comes off Muddles, resulting in his
burning. That counter then becomes a blood (not life) counter when it
moves onto Terrence, resulting in him gaining a blood. The Blood
Turnip now moves onto another minion of my choice.
Scenario B: A life counter comes off Muddles, resulting in his
burning. That counter is a life counter however, not blood, and thus
cannot go onto Terrence. The Blood Turnip now moves onto another
minion of my choice. (this is what I think would happen).
Scenario C: The Blood Turnip’s effect cannot happen, since life
counters can’t be moved onto vampires. The Turnip stays where it is
and nobody gains or loses anything.
